blocks.text: Condo buildings in Holly

Read this first: Holly has no verified apartment-condo stock. says so plainly and shows the checking. A buyer searching "Holly condos" is, in practice, looking at townhouses on 60B Street or at the apartment buildings in Delta Manor, Hawthorne and the Ladner Elementary sub-area.
Streets, schools and getting around Holly

items.t: Holly is east Ladner, built around Holly Elementary, 4625 62 Street, which is physically in the sub-area.
The SD37 School Locator result for the sample address 4625 62 Street is Holly Elementary (K–7) and Delta Secondary (8–12) at 4615 51 St.; catchments are address-based.

The working edges are Ladner Trunk Road (Highway 10) on the south and 64 Street on the east, with 60B Street as the street where new strata supply is actually landing. City of Delta material names townhouse development applications on 60B Street — 4726, 4740 and 4752 60B Street plus a portion of 6100 Ladner Trunk Road.

Transit: Ladner Exchange is the exchange named on TransLink's Ladner timetables; route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99, stopping at Ladner Exchange, and route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road and Arthur Drive. A bus route with a stop inside Holly itself: UNVERIFIED.

Where condo stock would concentrate if it existed: it does not — the strata growth in Holly is ground-oriented townhouse product on the 60B Street edge, next to Holly Park and Holly Elementary. A listing for the new Skye townhomes describes the location as beside Holly Park and Holly Elementary, with access to Ladner Village, Hwy 17, Hwy 99, Richmond, YVR and Tsawwassen Mills.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Holly

items.t: Presale rules (REDMA) — directly relevant to Skye: A presale buyer must receive a disclosure statement, and under s. 21 of the Real Estate Development Marketing Act the buyer has seven days to rescind, starting on the later of signing the purchase agreement or signing the written acknowledgement of the disclosure statement; deposits are generally held in trust.
Assignments: Read the assignment clause before signing if resale-before-completion matters.

SSMUH: Bylaws 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024: Delta's SSMUH zoning allows combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies.

Property transfer tax: General PTT is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2 million, 3% above $2 million, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3 million. The first-time buyers' exemption removes the tax on the first $500,000 (maximum saving $8,000) at $835,000 or less, phasing out to $860,000; the newly built home exemption is full to $1,100,000 and phases out by $1,150,000 — the exemption that matters for a new 60B Street townhome.

blocks.text: Good to know about Holly

items.t: 60B Street is Holly's growth edge, and it is townhouses, not condos. City material names townhouse applications at 4726, 4740 and 4752 60B Street plus part of 6100 Ladner Trunk Road, and a Bassi Properties townhouse application at 4739 and 4749 60B Street; Skye at Holly Park is the named project selling there, with Phase 1 move-in in 2026.
A Holly lot was already being marketed on the new density rules.
SSMUH arrived in 2024. Delta's June 24, 2024 adoption (Bylaws 8394 and 8395) lets many detached Holly lots add suites, duplex units, coach houses and garden suites without a rezoning.
There is no Holly market data in the standard stats pack.

Skye at Holly Park (Skye Townhomes) — 4732 60B Street; developer sales address 4760 60B St. STRATA

A new townhouse community by Bramor Developments — the developer describes parkside 3- and 4-bedroom townhomes in Ladner, now selling with Phase 1 move-in in 2026. Fresh check Nov 2, 2026: a current listing at the same address still records Building Type Townhouse, Ownership Type Freehold Strata, Year Built 2026, Units In Development 56, Strata Restrictions "Pets Allowed, Rentals Allowed" (listing data — confirm on the Form B / disclosure statement).
Hollyview Estates — 4767 64 Street. STRATA (bare-land, townhouse form)

Townhouse form on a bare-land strata: listing data classifies homes here as Townhouse, freehold strata, built 1992, and the listing text states the complex has only 13 units and describes the tenure in its own words — strata fees for a "bare land strata (this means you share the common property only & take care of your own home & yard within your fence)," with a roof replaced in 2012 (listing-stated for that unit — confirm scope in the strata documents). The guide pass upgraded Hollyview from the batch-1 research's name-only entry to verified townhouse-form bare-land strata on that listing evidence; the strata plan number remains UNCONFIRMED.

items.t: OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future" — correction carried openly: A single consolidated plan adopted July 8, 2024 — it contains NO lettered schedules; the East Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950, and farm land east of Holly is designated "Agriculture (A)". SSMUH / suites as Delta states them: Delta adopted its SSMUH zoning amendments as Bylaws 8394 and 8395 on June 24, 2024, allowing up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots and combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies.

GST on new construction: A new Skye townhome carries GST; a resale does not. The first-time home buyers' GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA News No. 122) rebates 100% of the GST up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements in the March 20, 2025–2031 window; the older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Holly

items.t: Zoning bylaw number: CONTESTED — flagged, never asserted: City pages cite the Delta Zoning Bylaw as No. 7600, 2017, while an internal consolidated title reading "8400, 2025" also circulates.

Subdivision and servicing standards — status stated precisely: the Delta Development and Subdivision Standards Bylaw No. 8288, 2024 is cited from civicweb / a January 2024 council report presenting it to repeal and replace Bylaw No. 7162, 2015.

: Form B (Strata Property Act s. 59) discloses the lot's strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance and insurance summary, and must be provided within 7 days of request (max $35 plus up to 25¢/page) — in a bare-land strata it is also how a buyer learns what the strata does and does not maintain, because the house itself is the owner's responsibility. Since July 1, 2024 every strata with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years — Hollyview's 13 lots are inside this rule; since November 1, 2023 the CRF must receive at least 10% of the operating fund annually. Rental-restriction bylaws are VOID province-wide since November 24, 2022; the only valid age bylaws are 55+ (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, May 1, 2023 exemptions), a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw, and no Holly complex is verified as 55+.

ALR block (edge parcels where ALR status is confirmed for the parcel): ALR residences cannot be stratified — depositing a strata plan is a subdivision (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)) — and subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval. Residence caps: principal residence ≤500 m² total floor area; a secondary suite only inside the principal residence; one additional residence of 90 m² or less on parcels of 40 ha or less, 186 m² or less on parcels over 40 ha.

Farm class (BC Assessment) — full three-tier form: $2,500 of gross farm income on a farm operation of 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha on operations over 4 ha; $10,000 on operations under 0.8 ha — applications by October 31 for the next taxation year.

Delta property taxes / holding cost: Delta's 2026 property tax due date was July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding balances after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% penalty on outstanding balances after September 2, 2026. A bare-land strata lot carries strata fees on top; a fee-simple lot does not.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Holly

Position stated at the top: Holly has NO verified pad-rental manufactured-home park — no park where a buyer owns a home (a chattel) and rents the pad. What Holly DOES have, uniquely in Ladner, is both bare-land strata forms in one sub-area — and those two communities are this section's subject.
The parks and communities

items.t: Hollyview Estates: The homes-side point for a mobile-home buyer: this is own-land stock, the opposite of a pad — the buyer owns the strata lot and the home on it, pays strata fees instead of pad rent, and takes the full strata document set (Form B, bylaws, depreciation report).

Ashley Green: Owners hold their own house and lot; the homes are half-duplexes rather than townhouse rows, and the strata's role is far narrower than in a conventional townhouse strata. Listings market Ashley Green in family terms ("steps to Holly Elementary," homes for "the next family"); no source states an age restriction for either community.

NOT a park and NOT mobile-home stock: Named here only so the sub-area's newest "park-named" product is not mistaken for a manufactured-home park — "Holly Park" in its name is a parkside marketing line, not a tenure.
RV parks/campgrounds: none is documented in Holly ground, and an RV park is not a manufactured-home park absent year-round manufactured-home tenure in a source.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Holly

items.t: Holly is in east Ladner, in the City of Delta, BC — Ladner is one of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta), and Ladner and Tsawwassen together are called South Delta. Holly falls under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), which consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan; the East Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950.
Nearby areas: Delta Manor and the Ladner village core to the west, East Delta farmland to the east, Hawthorne to the northwest.

The growth edge is 60B Street: City material names townhouse development applications at 4726, 4740 and 4752 60B Street plus a portion of 6100 Ladner Trunk Road, and a Bassi Properties townhouse application at 4739 and 4749 60B Street. That edge is conventional strata townhouse development (Skye at Holly Park), not park development.

Transit frame: Ladner Exchange is the exchange named on TransLink's Ladner timetables; route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99, stopping at Ladner Exchange; route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road and Arthur Drive.

Flood frame: Ladner is low land protected by the City's dike and drainage system — over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure. Any home sited on its own lot here sits inside that context; confirm flood construction requirements for the specific lot with the City.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers in Holly

items.t: CORE DISCIPLINE: the buyer owns the home (a chattel) and rents the pad.

Delta zoning / OCP frame: OCP = consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), NO lettered schedules (the East Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.1 under the OLD Bylaw No. 3950; farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)" — a "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" attribution anywhere is an ERROR; D.1 was a Tsawwassen schedule under 3950, not a Holly or 8400 schedule). Zoning number CONTESTED (7600, 2017 vs "8400, 2025") — flagged, never asserted. Parcel zoning is read off the City's zoning maps; the urban Ladner ladder includes RS5 (550/460 m²), RS6 (390 m²), RS7 (335 m²), RD1 (836 m²) and RD4 (504 m²). Park zoning is municipal — there is no province-wide park zone.

blocks.text: Good to know about Holly

items.t: Holly holds both of Ladner's bare-land strata forms in one sub-area: — townhouse-form (Hollyview) and half-duplex (Ashley Green) — which is why "strata" on a Holly listing tells a buyer nothing until the tenure is read: conventional strata at Skye, bare-land strata on 62nd and 64th, and fee-simple on the detached grid are three different purchases.

The listing sentence that settles Hollyview's tenure is the seller's own: "you share the common property only & take care of your own home & yard within your fence." That one line is the whole difference between a bare-land strata lot and both a conventional townhouse (where the strata carries the building exterior) and a park pad (where the buyer owns no land at all).

Streamside rule: all Delta properties within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, are in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area — check it before pricing an addition or a re-siting on any Holly lot near a ditch line.

faq.a: For the sample address 4625 62 Street, the SD37 School Locator returns Holly Elementary (K–7) at 4625 62 St. and Delta Secondary (8–12) at 4615 51 St.; catchments are address-based, so check any other address in the locator.

faq.q: Is Holly an official Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. "Holly" is an MLS/Paragon sub-area name; the City of Delta plans this part of east Ladner under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) — the former East Ladner Area Plan (Schedule B.1) belonged to the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950.

faq.q: Can a house lot in Holly add a suite or coach house?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH zoning amendments allow combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies, and the RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use.
Ladner sits on low land protected by the City of Delta's flood protection system — dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection, over 63 kilometres of infrastructure, plus 31 drainage pump stations.

faq.q: How do residents get to Richmond and Vancouver by transit?
faq.a: Route 601 runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line, stopping at Ladner Exchange, via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.

faq.q: Are there any condos in Holly at all?
faq.a: No apartment-condo building in Holly is verified on any source checked. The strata choice in Holly is townhouses (Skye at Holly Park and the 60B Street applications) and a bare-land strata of half-duplexes (Ashley Green). The nearest verified apartment condos are the 53 Street buildings in Hawthorne and Delta Manor.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Skye townhouses and a condo?
faq.a: Tenure is similar — freehold strata, monthly fees, bylaws — but the form is ground-oriented townhouse living next to Holly Park, not a shared apartment building, and a presale purchase carries REDMA disclosure and rescission rules that a resale does not.

faq.q: I signed a presale at Skye — can I change my mind?
faq.a: Yes, inside the window: REDMA s. 21 gives seven days from the later of signing or acknowledging the disclosure statement, by written notice to the developer. After day seven the contract is binding.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover in a bare-land strata like Ashley Green?
faq.a: Far less than in an apartment building — the house itself is the owner's problem. One listing records a $65/month fee at Ashley Green; the Form B and budget show exactly what that buys. Never assume building insurance or exterior maintenance is included in a bare-land strata.

faq.q: Can I rent out a townhouse here?
faq.a: For long-term rentals, BC law voids strata rental-restriction bylaws as of Nov 24, 2022; short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw. In a presale, also check the disclosure statement's rental disclosure.

faq.q: What townhouse choice actually exists in Holly?
faq.a: Ashley Green is a bare-land strata of half-duplexes — a neighbouring form, not a townhouse complex.

faq.q: I signed a presale at Skye — can I change my mind?
faq.a: Yes, inside the window: REDMA s. 21 gives seven days from the later of signing or acknowledging the disclosure statement, by written notice to the developer. After day seven the contract is binding, including its assignment terms.

faq.q: What is the difference between Hollyview's bare-land strata and Skye's strata?
faq.a: At Hollyview the listing states it plainly: you share the common property only and take care of your own home and yard within your fence — roof, exterior and house insurance are yours. At Skye, a conventional townhouse strata, the strata carries more of the building envelope and common systems, which is what the larger fee buys. The Form B and budget for each complex state the exact split.

faq.q: Is Hollyview Estates a mobile home park?
faq.a: Calling it a "park" describes its low-rise feel, not its tenure.

faq.q: What is the difference between Hollyview Estates and Ashley Green?
faq.a: Form. Hollyview is townhouse-form bare-land strata (13 units, 1992); Ashley Green is half-duplex bare-land strata (1990). Both are bare-land strata tenure; neither is a conventional townhouse strata like Skye, neither is fee-simple, and neither is a pad-rental park.
Not verified. The registered bylaws on the Form B are the only settling document.

faq.q: If I buy on a rented pad elsewhere, do I own land?
faq.a: No. You own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad under the MHPTA. Holly's two communities are the local counterexample: own the lot (strata form), no pad at all.
